dataList.place:
N公司法院 走廊
 N Corp. Courthouse Corridor
dataList.content:
哎呀，好久不见了，各位。时间过得可真快啊——自庄园一别，我们还没这样面对面过吧？
 My, it has been a long while, everyone. How time flies—we haven't stood face-to-face since the manor, have we?

……耐莉？
 ... Nelly?

她一身装束，风格令人联想起仇甫……看来她已受雇于N公司。
 She is garbed in the vestments of style reminiscent of Gubo's... It appears that she has entered N Corp.'s employment.

……我叫你做自己的事……可没让你跟赫尔曼那帮混蛋签约，然后逮着机会就来搞我们。
 ... When I told you to write your own tale... I didn't say you could sign on with Hermann's pack of tossers and come screwin' us over every chance you got.

你这回又是来搅什么局的……？
 What're you here to fuck up this time, anyway...?

希斯克利夫……
 Heathcliff...

你曾经——你曾经是家人！所以我才放你走的，该死！因为我不是瞎子，看得出那些在庄园的日子对你做了什么。可你……！光偷金枝还不够，是吧？你非得加入这——！ You were— You were family! That's why I let you go, dammit! Because I wasn't blind to what living in that manor did to you. But you...! Nickin' the Golden Bough weren't enough, was it? You had to join these—!

话音未落，希斯克利夫的球棒已经挥了出去。他毫不犹豫地朝耐莉冲了过去……
 Heathcliff's bat was already in motion before the last word had left his mouth. He surged toward Nelly without the slightest hesitation...

……耐莉袖中寒光一闪。她的匕首干净利落地一击，将球棒格开，随即后退一步——她神色间流露的与其说是恐惧，不如说是一种带着厌倦的困扰。
 ... and steel flashed from Nelly's sleeve. Her knife struck the bat aside with a clean crack, and she gave ground, her composure disturbed less by fear than by tiresome consternation.

等等。我是来帮你们的，希斯克利夫。别冲动。
 Wait. I'm here to help you, Heathcliff. Don't be rash.
帮我们？ Help me?

浮士德不动声色地轻轻点了点头。希斯克利夫看在眼里，猛地转向她，眼中杀意未消。
 Faust offered a small, silent nod. Heathcliff caught it and wheeled on her with murder still smoldering in his eyes.

解释。现在就说。
 Explain. Now.

……耐莉小姐确实是本次行动的协助者——通过与赫尔曼理事的新九人会达成的协议。
 ... Miss Nelly is indeed a collaborator in the present operation—by way of an agreement concluded with Director Hermann's New League of Nine Littérateurs.

……哈。难怪你一直瞒着我们大家。
 ... Huh. No wonder you've been keeping it all hush-hush from the rest of us.

没错。保密是为了减轻罪人们预料之中的抵触情绪。
 Correct. The secrecy was only intended to alleviate the much-expected reluctance from the Sinners.

耐莉……她已经背叛过我两次了。两次！
 Nelly... She's betrayed me twice already. Twice!

我都放她自由了——她转身又捅了我一刀！那我现在还得，什么，再信她一次？还得配合——
 Even after I'd freed her—she turned round and twisted the knife! And I'm supposed to, what, trust her again? And go along with—

咱们俩就把那儿发生过的一切都遗忘了吧，亲爱的希斯克利夫。我早就把那些都埋葬了。
 Let us both forget all that has transpired there, dear Heathcliff. I've buried it all already.

那座风雨交加、暗无天日的旧庄园的记忆，只会在心头缠绕得越来越紧。
 Memories of that stormy, lightless old manor do nothing but knot themselves tighter around the mind.
"遗忘"……？耐莉，你懂什么叫遗忘？ "Forget"...? What do you know about forgetting, Nelly?

……不，我不会遗忘。就算这世界把她遗忘了，我也不会——我不能。就算那是凯茜的心愿也一样。
 ... No, I won't forget them. Even if she's become forgotten to the world, I won't—I can't. Even if that were Cathy's wish.

所以不行，任何人都没法逼我把过去埋葬，耐莉。你不行，谁都不行。
 So no, I won't let anyone force me to leave the past buried, Nelly. Not you, not anyone.

凯茜……？我又听不懂你在说什么了，希斯克利夫。就跟我们上次见面时一样。
 Cathy...? You've lost me again, Heathcliff. Just as you did the last time we met.

这……这些年我在那座废弃的庄园里，感觉就像是在伺候一个幽灵，希斯克利夫。你可能不知道……恩肖先生去世后，愿他安息，那座庄园就……彻底空了下来，没人住。
 It's... it's as though I'd been serving a ghost all those years at that abandoned manor, Heathcliff. You wouldn't know this, but... after Mister Earnshaw's death, rest his soul, the manor was left... completely unoccupied.

你伺候的才不是什么幽灵。那座庄园有正牌的女主人，该死！
 You weren't servin' a ghost. That manor had a rightful mistress, dammit!

……我看这个话题该到此为止了。
 ... I think it's high time we moved on from this subject.

要是让这场不愉快的对话没完没了地继续下去，哪一方损失更大，应该已经再明显不过了。浮士德小姐，是不是？
 It should be painfully apparent which party has more to lose if we let this distasteful conversation go on and on. Would you not agree, Miss Faust?

希斯克利夫，抱歉，可是——
 Heathcliff, I'm sorry, but—

……行啊，说来听听。你到底打算怎么帮我们？
 ... Go on, let's hear it. Just how do you intend on helping us?

浮士德刚要挪步插到两人中间，希斯克利夫终于让开了一步。他的球棒极不情愿地一寸一寸放低……
 Faust had scarcely begun to move between them when Heathcliff finally yielded a step. His bat lowered one reluctant inch at a time...

……可他的视线依旧死死盯着耐莉，仿佛正想起旧日背叛留下的伤痕。
 ... though his glare remained fixed upon Nelly, as though he were recalling the old wound of betrayal.

我的天……我在庄园那会儿就注意到了，你可真是变软了呢？过去的希斯克利夫已经——
 My word... I made a note of this back at the manor too, but you've certainly grown soft, haven't you? The old Heathcliff would've—

再说一个字。再多说一个惹火的字，你就能亲眼见识见识你嘴里念叨的那个"过去的希斯克利夫"把你脑袋敲飞。
 Say another word. Another infuriatin' word, and your eyes just might see the "old Heathcliff" you like blatherin' on about, 'fore I knock your head clean off your shoulders.

*吐了口烟* 还有话要说？那接着说吧。正好给我点时间，考虑是折·脖，还是拿下你的小.脑.。
 *puff* Got more to say? Then blather away. It'll give me time to decide between S.Y.N.C. and having your L.B.

……我在附近租了间会议室，我们不如移步过去继续谈？想必大家都不希望让其他合作者久等。
 ... I've rented a conference room nearby, so why don't we continue our discussion there? I'm sure we don't want to keep the other collaborators waiting.

再说，这里也不是讨论这类……敏感话题的好地方，对吧？
 Besides, this isn't exactly the best place to discuss these rather... sensitive subjects, is it?

其他合作者是指……？
 The other collaborators being...?

不过是几位老相识罢了，和我一样，不需要费心介绍。
 Only a handful of dear old acquaintances who, much like me, require no laborious introduction.

*吐了口烟* 同意，球棒男。记忆这东西可挑不了要记住什么、忘掉什么。
 *puff* Agreed, Bats. Can't pick and choose what to remember and what to forget.

dataList.place:
N公司内的一间会议厅
 A Conference Hall in N Corp.
dataList.content:
我们跟着耐莉走进了一栋建筑里的某会议室。
 We followed Nelly into some kind of conference room in a building.

在那里，我们发现自己置身于"几位老相识"之中——说是"一堆无礼的惊吓"还差不多——他们的脸全都转向了我们。
 And there, we found ourselves in the company of the "handful of dear old acquaintances"—handful of rude surprise, really—whose faces were all turned toward us.

dataList.title:
N公司 - 新九人会

dataList.content:
虽说我确实建议过，招募范围该扩大到我过去认识的人……不过他这张脸，倒真是意料之外。
 While I do recall urging them to expand the hiring pool to those from my past... He is indeed a most unexpected face.

真奇怪……我不记得对你，或是我们团队里的任何人，隐瞒过这项情报。
 How odd... I don't recall keeping any of this information classified from you, or anyone in our team.

dataList.content:
……那家伙不是被排除在外。他只是自己选择缺席了那次通报会议，理由是要专心搞研究。
 ... That fellow wasn't left out. He simply decided to be absent during the dissemination session, on account of focusing more on his research.

dataList.title:
N公司 - 新九人会
 N Corp. - New League of Nine Littérateurs
dataList.content:
这份理解我心领了；毕竟我身兼数职嘛。
 The understanding of which I do appreciate; I wear many hats, after all.

赫尔曼理事解救默尔索先生的计划，准备工作都完成了吧？
 Director Hermann's plan to rescue Mister Meursault—I trust the preparations are complete?

dataList.title:
N公司 - 新九人会
 N Corp. - New League of Nine Littérateurs
dataList.content:
啊，是的——经由自杀贩卖机的迂回渗透路线。各项系统当然都已就位，随时可以启动——这准备工作不算复杂。
 Ah, yes—the circuitous infiltration route by way of the Suicide Vending Machine. All systems in place and ready to commence, of course—it's a simple enough preparation to make.

很好。大家都听到了吧？都满意了吗？那么请入座。
 Good. We all heard that, yes? All chuffed? Then please be seated.

按照耐莉的示意就座之后……
 After we were seated as per Nelly's directions...

我朝旁边椅子上的奥提斯凑了过去。把自打我们再次遇见耐莉后，一直萦绕在我心头的疑问，一字一句地问了出来。
 I leaned toward Outis in the adjoining chair. I ticked out the question that had been needling me ever since we ran into Nelly again.

<有件事我必须弄清楚……你觉得他们从这件事里能捞到什么好处？>
 <There's something I've got to know... What do you think they have to gain from this?>

执行经理，这次合作很可能是某种交易的结果，而非双方互惠计算的产物。
 This collaboration is most likely an outcome of a transaction rather than that of a mutually beneficial calculation, Executive Manager.

要凭猜测来说的话，这笔交易多半跟镜子脱不了关系。
 A transaction that must've had something to do with the Mirror, if I am to speak based on guesswork.

若他们是靠打着"九人会"之名，将吾昔日同伴纳入麾下……奥提斯小姐的推测，恐怕确实不虚。
 If they brought my past fellows into their fold by means of selling the name "League of Nine"... Miss Outis's conjecture may indeed be true.

dataList.title:
N公司 - 新九人会
 N Corp. - New League of Nine Littérateurs
dataList.content:
呵。看来我们不必费心多加解释了——诸位客人对自己的处境倒是心知肚明。
 Well. It seems we need not engage in overlong elucidation—our guests are entirely self-informed as to their circumstances.

dataList.title:
N公司 - 新九人会
 N Corp. - New League of Nine Littérateurs
dataList.content:
*嗤笑* 这又不是我们头一回打交道了。要是连这么明摆着的事都看不出来……啊，那可说明不了你什么好话。
 *scoff* This is hardly our first encounter. If you're still incapable of noticing something so painfully obvious... well, you wouldn't like what that says about your competence.

……该死，痛快说吧。你们这帮人到底图什么？
 ... Bloody hell, spit it out already. What do you lot have to gain from this?

契约的那部分内容，仍属机密，希斯克利夫。
 That portion of the contract remains confidential, Heathcliff.

不过我可以给你一个保证。跟上次的安排不同，这次我们没打算染指金枝。只是恰巧，帮你们一把，让我们的目标更容易达成罢了。
 I can offer one reassurance, though. Unlike in our previous arrangement, we have no intention of claiming the Golden Bough. It just so happens that our goal becomes more achievable by providing you with assistance.

你们莫非又想像鸿园那样，让我们在浑然不觉之中沦为搅乱秩序的工具？想必是图谋某物，唯有借骚乱掩护方可得手……
 Do you seek to make us into unwitting agents of chaos, as you had in Hongyuan? Presumably after aught that can only be purloined only under the cover of tumult...

dataList.title:
N公司 - 新九人会
 N Corp. - New League of Nine Littérateurs
dataList.content:
无论有意与否，你与你的新同伴每到一处，往往便是混乱的化身。又或者，李箱，是你自己在同伴之中埋下了种子？
 You and your new fellows are quite often the agents of chaos whitherever you venture, unwitting or not. Or could your presence among your fellows have sown the seeds, Yi Sang?

……你的指控，不过是以偏概全。
 ... Your accusation is but a gross generalization.

dataList.title:
N公司 - 新九人会
 N Corp. - New League of Nine Littérateurs
dataList.content:
若这样能让你好受些，尽管用更委婉的措辞去修饰记录吧。可事实终归是不变的真相，它可不在乎我是否同情。
 Embroider the record with gentler thread if it comforts you. The reality of the matter is a truth immutable that cares not for my sympathies.

dataList.title:
N公司 - 新九人会
 N Corp. - New League of Nine Littérateurs
dataList.content:
好了，说回计划本身……老实说，其实相当简单。你们同伴被送去的地方，叫做西西弗百货。而在正常情况下，唯一能获准进入那家百货公司的途径，就是西西弗刑。
 Well, moving on to the plan itself... Frankly, it's all rather simple. The place your fellow has been sent to is called Grand Magasin Sisyphe. And under normal circumstances, the only way by which entrance to that department store is permitted is the Sisyphe Penalty.

敢问，莫非我们亦须遭受绞刑？
 Pray, are we to be hanged, too, then?

dataList.title:
N公司 - 新九人会
 N Corp. - New League of Nine Littérateurs
dataList.content:
请你说明一下，此问是照字面意思提出的，还是拐弯抹角的暗示？
 Would you mind clarifying whether that query was posed in a literal sense, or if it were merely circumlocutory insinuation?

dataList.title:
N公司 - 新九人会
 N Corp. - New League of Nine Littérateurs
dataList.content:
视你这问题的性质而定，也可以说是一语中的。
 Depending on the nature of your query, one could say that you hit the nail on the head.

dataList.title:
N公司 - 新九人会
 N Corp. - New League of Nine Littérateurs
dataList.content:
若你指的是后者，那便正确——想必诸位从方才那场行刑中已经看出来了，唯有经历死亡，方可获准进入西西弗百货。
 You would be correct if the latter were your insinuation—as you all must have gathered from observing the execution of the penalty, one must experience death to gain access to the Grand Magasin Sisyphe.

dataList.title:
N公司 - 新九人会
 N Corp. - New League of Nine Littérateurs
dataList.content:
然而幸运的是，据传闻，西西弗百货近来遇到了一些……麻烦。从其目前经验糊原料的产量来看，这传闻倒也属实。
 As luck would have it, however, word is that the Grand Magasin has recently faced some... difficulties. Word proven true, considering its current production rate of the Experience Batter.

dataList.content:
而这，正好开了一道裂缝——一条平常无法通行的路径，用个比方来说，我们便可借此把你们"塞"进去。
 And this has opened a crack, or a normally inaccessible avenue through which we may, in a proverbial sense, "squeeze you through."

dataList.title:
N公司 - 新九人会

dataList.content:
真是走运，我们身边正好有这座都市里最擅长把自己弄死的专家。
 What luck that we are in the presence of the City's top experts at getting themselves killed.

你说得……也没错，可是……
 You're not... wrong, but...

可是……经理老兄没死过吧？
 But... Manager Bud's never died before, have they?

没错，不过也就是名义上没死过而已。我们死的时候感受的每一分痛，但丁也都感受得到。
 Nah, but only technically. Every pain we feel when we die, Dante feels 'em too.

不过，我还是忍不住替但丁担心……死亡带来的可不只是痛，还有别的感受……
 Still, I can't help but worry for Dante... Pain isn't the only feeling death brings, after all...

dataList.title:

dataList.content: 哈，是吗？你还会担心死亡这种事？我记得你说过人类是……怎么说来着？"生而为死"？ Hah, really? You're worried about death? I thought you said humans were... what was it again? "Born to die"?

哥哥，我那时候说的那些话，其实……我是——
 Brother, what I said then, it was... I'm—

dataList.title:
N公司 - 新九人会

贾宝玉。
 Jia Baoyu.

dataList.title:

我还以为你现在该学乖了。我们俩都清楚，你嘴边那句道歉，既不是善意，也不是悔意，不过是个令人作呕的小谎话罢了。
 I'd have expected you to know better now. We both know the apology waiting behind your teeth is not kindness, nor is it remorse. It is a revolting little lie.

在我看来，鸿璐只能把话咽回去，他回望贾环的眼神里，既有愧疚，也有绝望……
 It appeared to me that Hong Lu could only swallow his words as he stared back at Jia Huan with a look that was as much guilt as it was desperation...

然而这番反应反倒让贾环更加恼火，他张了张嘴，几次想说些什么，可当他注意到周围众人打量的目光时，猛地扭过头去，一言不发。
 Further infuriated by this response, however, Jia Huan opened and closed his mouth a few times as though he were trying to say something. But when he registered the circle of watching faces, he snapped his head aside emphatically without another word.

While it's not as widely recognized or popular as Canned Experience, it's been spreading via word of mouth, because the service it offers is extremely thrilling...

 And I suppose that is another technology purloined from the Glass Window or the Mirror.

dataList.title:

哈！事到如今，你还任由这点私人恩怨左右自己？
